response.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Senior Backend Engineer position at Brightwave Payments. With over five years of professional software engineering experience, I have led the design, build, and operation of high‑throughput microservices at TechCorp, handling more than 1 M requests per day [c4, c5, c2]. In my recent role as Senior Software Engineer, I architected services in Python, deployed them on AWS, and containerized them with Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring reliable production workloads [c3, c10].

My background also includes designing PostgreSQL schemas and developing REST APIs during my tenure at StartupXYZ, where I worked with JavaScript, Node.js, and React to deliver a responsive dashboard [c8, c7, c10]. I have built CI/CD pipelines, managed Git repositories, and maintained cloud infrastructure on AWS, all of which have been applied to production environments [c10, c3]. While I have not yet worked with FastAPI, EKS, RDS, or SQS, I have extensive experience with Python and Kubernetes in production, and I am eager to extend my skill set to these technologies [c3, c10].

Beyond individual contributions, I have mentored a team of five engineers and led technical design reviews, ensuring code quality and architectural consistency [c5, c2]. I am comfortable taking ownership of containerized deployments and continuously improving CI/CD processes, which aligns with Brightwave’s focus on scalable, reliable services [c10, c3].

I am eager to bring my experience in Python, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and REST API design to Brightwave Payments, and I look forward to discussing how I can help scale your payment platform. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,  
John Doe
response.score_reasoning: The resume provides evidence for all core requirements except the optional Terraform/Kafka/observability stack.  Python microservices, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, React, team leadership, and 5+ years of experience are all supported by chunks [c3], [c4], [c10], [c8], [c7], [c5], [c2], and [c6].  The only gaps are the specific FastAPI framework, EKS, RDS, SQS, Terraform, Kafka, Prometheus, and Grafana, which are not mentioned in any evidence chunk.
